run_ui_md_lines: Type on a path / Area Type: select a vector layer, open Path Operations (Shift+F8), type the text in Type > Text, then Type on Path or Area Type (inset from Area inset). The text draws live and follows path edits; Edit > Undo removes the binding.
Convert Point / Area Type: select a point-text layer (or a vector layer holding area text) and press Convert Point / Area Type; one Undo restores the original.
Create Outlines: select a point-text layer or a vector layer with live text and press Create Outlines; the text becomes filled paths in one undo step.
The status log echoes each live text: 'live text <id>: N glyphs placed[, M overset]' or vector_text_not_provided with the reason.
